answer: Latency-Shaped Admission Gate: each identity must sustain a pre-declared arrival curve over the first hour, with inter-arrival variance matching a planted garden of organic traffic rather than bursts. Deviation beyond the envelope throttles the account to a slow voyage through probation, capping outbound actions until the curve stabilizes. At the vertex where a cluster of accounts shares timing fingerprints, the gate collapses them into one identity slot, forcing attackers to rent and warm real hosts across many hours per attempt.
